name: nf-snmp
description: SNMP driver plugin for Normal Framework: device profiles, discovery, polling via NF's poll service, traps and SET.

scripts.check:syntax: find lib hooks bin tools -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
scripts.profiles:import: node tools/import-datadog.mjs && node tools/fetch-mibs.mjs --profiles && node tools/verify-profiles.mjs
